before.scenario: A company has a helper chatbot for its staff. An employee wants to know how many leave days they can carry into next year.
before.starting_input: How many leave days can I carry into next year?

source_materials.title: Leave Policy
source_materials.content: Employees may carry a maximum of 5 unused leave days into the next calendar year.

source_materials.title: Travel Policy
source_materials.content: Employees must book work travel at least 7 days before the trip.

source_materials.title: Office Hours
source_materials.content: The office is open from 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Friday.

before.intermediate_step:
Use only the information below to answer the question.
Information: Employees may carry a maximum of 5 unused leave days into the next calendar year.
Question: How many leave days can I carry into next year?
before.final_result: You can carry up to 5 unused leave days into next year. This comes from the Leave Policy.

after.scenario: RAG can be used by companies to answer questions from their documents.

modifications.description: Replaced the worked example with a one-line mention and removed the walkthrough.
